name: P4 − P1
user: Where P4 is relative to P1: the dual Purkinje (DPI) signal. It changes when the eye rotates and hardly at all when the eye or the camera shifts. A calibration turns it into degrees.
developer: dpi/p4 minus dpi/p1, in image pixels, from the same frame (DPI-SPEC 1, 4). Good only when both are; otherwise the status of the one missing (P1's first).

fields.name: P4 − P1
fields.help: x and y of P4 minus those of P1.
